name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 13 – Am 32
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13b. Believes that, in view of rising living costs and their substantial impact on the lives of workers and their families, rising inequality and social injustices, and the persistently high level of poverty and social exclusion, the 2027 budget needs to allocate significantly more resources to the European Social Fund Plus, so as to help Member States address these challenges;
